title: Three Men of Gotham
author: James Baldwin
summary: 两个哥谭人为并不存在的羊争吵，第三个用一袋面粉点破他们的愚蠢。
publicDomainBasis: Published 1896 by the American Book Company; author James Baldwin (1841–1925). Public domain in the United States and in China (author's life plus 70 years).

paragraphs.en: There is a town in England called Gotham, and many merry stories are told of the queer people who used to live there.
paragraphs.zh: 英格兰有一座小镇叫哥谭，那里流传着许多关于从前住在那里的古怪人们的趣事。

paragraphs.en: One day two men of Gotham met on a bridge. Hodge was coming from the market, and Peter was going to the market.
paragraphs.zh: 一天，两个哥谭人在一座桥上相遇。霍奇正从集市回来，彼得正要去集市。

paragraphs.en: "Where are you going?" said Hodge.
paragraphs.zh: “你要去哪儿？”霍奇问。

paragraphs.en: "I am going to the market to buy sheep," said Peter.
paragraphs.zh: “我要去集市买羊。”彼得说。

paragraphs.en: "Buy sheep?" said Hodge. "And which way will you bring them home?"
paragraphs.zh: “买羊？”霍奇说，“那你打算从哪条路把它们赶回家？”

paragraphs.en: "I shall bring them over this bridge," said Peter.
paragraphs.zh: “我要把它们从这座桥上赶过去。”彼得说。

paragraphs.en: "No, you shall not," said Hodge.
paragraphs.zh: “不行，你不能从这儿过。”霍奇说。

paragraphs.en: "Yes, but I will," said Peter.
paragraphs.zh: “不，我就要从这儿过。”彼得说。

paragraphs.en: "You shall not," said Hodge.
paragraphs.zh: “你不能。”霍奇说。

paragraphs.en: "I will," said Peter.
paragraphs.zh: “我偏要。”彼得说。

paragraphs.en: Then they beat with their sticks on the ground as though there had been a hundred sheep between them.
paragraphs.zh: 于是他们用棍子敲打地面，仿佛两人之间真有一百只羊似的。

paragraphs.en: "Take care!" cried Peter. "Look out that my sheep don't jump on the bridge."
paragraphs.zh: “当心！”彼得喊道，“看好我的羊，别让它们跳到桥上去。”

paragraphs.en: "I care not where they jump," said Hodge; "but they shall not go over it."
paragraphs.zh: “它们往哪儿跳我不管，”霍奇说，“但就是不许它们过桥。”

paragraphs.en: "But they shall," said Peter.
paragraphs.zh: “它们偏要过。”彼得说。

paragraphs.en: "Have a care," said Hodge; "for if you say too much, I will put my fingers in your mouth."
paragraphs.zh: “你小心点，”霍奇说，“你要是再多嘴，我就把手指伸进你嘴里。”

paragraphs.en: "Will you?" said Peter.
paragraphs.zh: “你敢？”彼得说。

paragraphs.en: Just then another man of Gotham came from the market with a sack of meal on his horse. He heard his neighbors quarreling about sheep; but he could see no sheep between them, and so he stopped and spoke to them.
paragraphs.zh: 正在这时，另一个哥谭人骑马从集市回来，马上驮着一袋面粉。他听见邻居们为羊争吵，可两人之间根本看不见羊，于是停下来跟他们说话。

paragraphs.en: "Ah, you foolish fellows!" he cried. "It is strange that you will never learn wisdom.—Come here, Peter, and help me lay my sack on my shoulder."
paragraphs.zh: “唉，你们这两个傻瓜！”他喊道，“真奇怪，你们怎么从来学不会聪明点。——过来，彼得，帮我把这袋面粉扛到肩上。”

paragraphs.en: Peter did so, and the man carried his meal to the side of the bridge.
paragraphs.zh: 彼得照做了，那人把面粉扛到桥边。

paragraphs.en: "Now look at me," he said, "and learn a lesson." And he opened the mouth of the sack, and poured all the meal into the river.
paragraphs.zh: “现在看着我，”他说，“好好学一课。”说着，他解开袋口，把面粉全都倒进了河里。

paragraphs.en: "Now, neighbors," he said, "can you tell how much meal is in my sack?"
paragraphs.zh: “好了，邻居们，”他说，“你们能告诉我，我袋子里还有多少面粉吗？”

paragraphs.en: "There is none at all!" cried Hodge and Peter together.
paragraphs.zh: “一点也没有了！”霍奇和彼得异口同声地喊道。

paragraphs.en: "You are right," said the man; "and you that stand here and quarrel about nothing, have no more sense in your heads than I have meal in my sack!"
paragraphs.zh: “说得对，”那人说，“而你们站在这里为子虚乌有的事争吵，脑子里的见识，就跟我袋子里的面粉一样多！”
